Title: Senior Python Backend Engineer
Must have: Python, Django
Nice to have: PostgreSQL, Docker, AWS, Celery
Minimum experience: 5 years

About the role:
We are looking for a backend engineer to build and scale the APIs behind our e-commerce platform. You will design database schemas, write Django services, own background job processing and help us move more workloads to the cloud.
